import builtins
import numpy as np
from rerun.experimental import RrdReader
def read(path):
    poses, static, timelines = {}, set(), set()
    for c in RrdReader(path).store().stream():
        if c.is_static:
            static.add(c.entity_path)
            continue
        timelines.update(c.timeline_names)
        b = c.to_record_batch()
        if 'Transform3D:translation' not in b.schema.names:
            continue
        rows = zip(b.column('tick').to_pylist(), b.column('Transform3D:translation').to_pylist())
        for tick, t in rows:
            poses.setdefault(c.entity_path, {})[tick] = np.asarray(t, dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1)[:3]
    return poses, static, timelines
builtins.rr_read = read
def checked():
    return next(a for a in app.actions.list() if a['id'] == 'rerun.stream')['checked']
builtins.rr_checked = checked

from nuka.editor import nkrec
poses, static, timelines = rr_read(r'${out}/a.rrd')
rec = nkrec.read(r'${out}/a.nkrec')
names = rec.manifest['links']
links = {e: p for e, p in poses.items() if e.startswith('/world/links/')}
print('RR_LINKS', sorted(links))
assert len(links) == ${a}['links'] and all(e.startswith('/world/links/go2') for e in links), sorted(links)
assert {'tick', 'sim_time'} <= timelines and set(links) <= static, (timelines, static)
for e, p in links.items():
    assert sorted(p) == list(range(0, 41, 4)), (e, sorted(p))
last = next(s for s in rec.samples if s.tick == 40)
for row, pose in enumerate(last.links):
    e = '/' + nkrec._entity('links', names, row)
    assert (links[e][40] == pose[:3]).all(), (e, links[e][40], pose[:3])
assert any((p[0] != p[40]).any() for p in links.values())

assert not rr_checked()
poses, static, timelines = rr_read(r'${out}/b.rrd')
links = [p for e, p in poses.items() if e.startswith('/world/links/go2')]
assert links and all(sorted(p) == [40, 50, 60, 70] for p in links), [sorted(p) for p in links]
boxes = [e for e in poses if e.startswith('/world/bodies/') and 'box' in e]
assert len(boxes) == 1 and sorted(poses[boxes[0]]) == [70], (sorted(poses), boxes)

import sys
from nuka.editor.app import ActionError
saved = sys.modules['rerun']
sys.modules['rerun'] = None
try:
    app.actions.run('rerun.stream', on=True, file=r'${out}/c.rrd')
    raise AssertionError('streamed without rerun-sdk')
except ActionError as e:
    assert 'rerun-sdk' in str(e), str(e)
finally:
    sys.modules['rerun'] = saved
assert not rr_checked()
